mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_usuario WHERE bo_congresista = true
SELECT tipo, COUNT(*) as count FROM ev_checkin WHERE fc_registro BETWEEN #{startOfDay} AND #{endOfDay} GROUP BY tipo
SELECT HOUR(fc_registro) as hour, COUNT(*) as count FROM ev_checkin WHERE fc_registro BETWEEN #{startOfDay} AND #{endOfDay} GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

SELECT CONCAT(LPAD(HOUR(fc_registro), 2, '0'), ':', LPAD(FLOOR(MINUTE(fc_registro) / 15) * 15, 2, '0')) as slot, COUNT(*) as count FROM ev_checkin WHERE fc_registro BETWEEN #{startOfDay} AND #{endOfDay} GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot

SELECT t.titulo, COUNT(c.id_checkin) as count FROM ev_checkin c JOIN tr_taller t ON c.id_taller = t.id_taller WHERE c.fc_registro BETWEEN #{startOfDay} AND #{endOfDay} GROUP BY t.titulo ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id_usuario, p.nombre_completo FROM sys_usuario p WHERE p.bo_congresista = true AND p.id_usuario NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT c.id_usuario FROM ev_checkin c WHERE c.fc_registro BETWEEN #{startOfDay} AND #{endOfDay} )
